Method of Attack: Abusing the vulnerable Genshin Impact anti-cheat driver to disable antivirus software
Reading/writing kernel memory with kernel mode privileges from user mode
Enumerating threads and terminating processes with highest privileges
Installing the driver via malicious executables (kill_svc.exe, HelpPane.exe)
Dropping and executing ransomware payload (svchost.exe) after disabling antivirus
Attack Vector: Transfer and installation of vulnerable driver via malicious executables
Use of stolen admin credentials to connect via RDP to domain controller
Execution of batch scripts and malicious files to disable antivirus and deploy ransomware
Indicators of Compromise: Files: kill_svc.exe, HelpPane.exe, logon.bat, avg.msi, svchost.exe
Network share containing driver, ransomware, and kill_svc.exe for mass deployment
